standard: FlowSmith Strict Audit Standard V2 (Rule 29: No False 100%)
scope_definition: Curated Tier-1 Enterprise Automation Reference Set (60 Canonical SaaS & Enterprise Applications)

STRICT_NATIVE_COVERAGE.scope: Certified native FlowSmith connectors only (Salesforce, Dynamics 365, HubSpot, Jira, Slack, S3, Stripe, Postgres, etc.)
STRICT_NATIVE_COVERAGE.limitations: Excludes generated connectors and Universal HTTP templates

GENERATED_CONNECTOR_COVERAGE.limitations: Only counted when code generation is compiled and registered in ConnectorRegistry

TOTAL_DEDICATED_CONNECTOR_COVERAGE.scope: All dedicated connectors registered in ConnectorRegistry

UNIVERSAL_HTTP_COVERAGE.scope: Applications without dedicated connectors that are fully executable via Universal HTTP Request node with cURL/REST config
UNIVERSAL_HTTP_COVERAGE.limitations: Requires manual endpoint/auth configuration or cURL import by user

MCP_COVERAGE.scope: First-class Model Context Protocol tool execution
MCP_COVERAGE.limitations: Applies to MCP-compliant servers connected at runtime

TOTAL_EXECUTABLE_CAPABILITY_COVERAGE.scope: Full platform capability including native, generated, and Universal HTTP protocol execution
TOTAL_EXECUTABLE_CAPABILITY_COVERAGE.limitations: Distinguishes dedicated connector experience from raw HTTP execution

OPERATION_EXECUTION_INTEGRITY.scope: All 370 operations across all 69 registered FlowSmith connectors
OPERATION_EXECUTION_INTEGRITY.limitations: Excludes 2 operations marked registered-only awaiting payload mapping
